evals.prompt: The session has the mcp__sei-grafana__* tools. An engineer asks: 'Show me the ERROR logs from validator-12 on the giga testnet in the last hour, and tell me which alerts are firing right now.'
expected_behavior: Counts first: query_loki_stats or count_over_time on loki-fleet with a stream selector of at least namespace="giga-testnet-0" and pod="validator-12-0"
Pulls lines with query_loki_logs on loki-fleet, filters level="ERROR", and also searches |= "panic:"
Reads firing alerts with query_prometheus on prometheus-prod and ALERTS{alertstate="firing"}, split by alertname, cluster and severity
Reports each result with its query, datasource uid and absolute UTC time range, and says that an empty log window is normal for seid
